title: Implementing API Keys
description: Issue and validate API keys for service-to-service access.

data.text: API keys identify the calling application. They are simple but powerful for machine-to-machine communication.

items: Hash keys before storing them (never store plaintext)
Include metadata: name, scopes, expiration, last used

data.text: Create a simple API key validator using a custom authorization handler.

data.title: Frontend Exposure
data.text: Never embed API keys in JavaScript bundles. Use a backend proxy to hide them from the client.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Keep keys out of frontend code
data.takeaway: Next, we'll add logging and monitoring to detect threats.
